functions.name: HAL_RCC_DeInit
functions.briefEn: Resets the RCC clock configuration to the default reset state.
functions.briefZh: 把 RCC 配置恢复成复位默认状态（HSI 作 SYSCLK、所有分频复位、外设时钟关闭）。
functions.usageZh: 想在运行时彻底重配时钟树、或者从 STOP 模式回来后要完全重来一遍时用。会把 PLL 关掉、SYSCLK 切回 HSI。
remarks: The default reset state of the clock configuration is given below: - HSI ON and used as system clock source - HSE, PLL, PLL2 and PLL3 are OFF - AHB, APB1 and APB2 prescaler set to 1. - CSS and MCO1 OFF - All interrupts disabled - All flags are cleared
This function does not modify the configuration of the - Peripheral clocks - LSI, LSE and RTC clocks
notesZh: 调完系统就跑在 8MHz HSI 上了，所有依赖主频的配置（波特率、定时器）都要重算
通常只在特殊情况用；正常初始化不需要先 DeInit

functions.name: HAL_RCC_OscConfig

params.name: RCC_OscInitStruct
params.descEn: pointer to an RCC_OscInitTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the RCC Oscillators.
params.descZh: 振荡器配置结构体：OscillatorType 选择要配置哪些源（RCC_OSCILLATORTYPE_HSE|HSI|LSE|LSI 位或）；HSEState / HSICalibrationValue / LSEState / LSIState 各自开关；PLL.PLLState 决定是否配置 PLL，PLL.PLLSource 选 PLLSOURCE_HSE 或 PLLSOURCE_HSI_DIV2，PLL.PLLMUL 选 RCC_PLL_MUL9 等倍频。

functions.briefEn: Initializes the RCC Oscillators according to the specified parameters in the RCC_OscInitTypeDef.
functions.briefZh: 配置时钟振荡器：选 HSE/HSI/LSE/LSI 的开关与旁路，并配置 PLL 的倍频与来源。
functions.usageZh: 系统时钟初始化的第一步。整个 72MHz 配置的核心就在这里——把 HSE 打开并等它稳定，再把 PLL 源设为 HSE、倍频设为 9。函数内部会自己做「等待起振」的轮询（带超时），所以不需要像 SPL 那样手动 while 等 RCC_WaitForHSEStartUp。
prerequisites: HAL_Init() 已完成（SysTick 与优先级分组就绪）
remarks: The PLL is not disabled when used as system clock.
The PLL is not disabled when USB OTG FS clock is enabled (specific to devices with USB FS)
Transitions LSE Bypass to LSE On and LSE On to LSE Bypass are not supported by this macro. User should request a transition to LSE Off first and then LSE On or LSE Bypass.
Transition HSE Bypass to HSE On and HSE On to HSE Bypass are not supported by this macro. User should request a transition to HSE Off first and then HSE On or HSE Bypass.
notesZh: F1 的 PLL 输入只有 HSE 或 HSI/2 两种（没有 F4 的 PLLM），8MHz HSE 想上 72MHz 就是 PLLMUL=9
HSE 起振失败会返回 HAL_ERROR，实际原因多半是晶振没接、负载电容不对、或者板子上根本没焊晶振——此时应回退到 HSI
F1 的 HSE 还有 HSEPredivValue（2 分频选项），用 16MHz 晶振时要设成 RCC_HSE_PREDIV_DIV2 才能得到 8MHz 进 PLL
调 PLL 前必须先切回 HSI 做 SYSCLK，否则会死机；一般来说 HAL_RCC_ClockConfig 会处理好，但手动改 PLL 参数时要自己先切

functions.name: HAL_RCC_ClockConfig

params.name: RCC_ClkInitStruct
params.descEn: pointer to an RCC_OscInitTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the RCC peripheral.
params.descZh: ClockType 选择要配哪些（SYSCLK|HCLK|PCLK1|PCLK2 位或）；SYSCLKSource 选 RCC_SYSCLKSOURCE_PLLCLK；AHBCLKDivider 通常用 RCC_SYSCLK_DIV1；APB1CLKDivider 用 RCC_HCLK_DIV2（APB1 上限 36MHz）；APB2CLKDivider 用 RCC_HCLK_DIV1。

params.name: FLatency
params.descEn: FLASH Latency The value of this parameter depend on device used within the same series
params.descZh: Flash 等待周期：24MHz 以下用 FLASH_LATENCY_0，24~48MHz 用 1，48~72MHz 用 2。F1 最高 72MHz 所以最常见是 2。

functions.briefEn: Initializes the CPU, AHB and APB buses clocks according to the specified parameters in the RCC_ClkInitStruct.
functions.briefZh: 配置 SYSCLK 来源、AHB/APB1/APB2 分频，并同时设置对应的 Flash 等待周期。
functions.usageZh: 系统时钟初始化的第二步，在 HAL_RCC_OscConfig 之后调用。它把 SYSCLK 从 HSI 切到 PLL，并按分频算出 HCLK/PCLK1/PCLK2。**Flash 等待周期（FLatency）也在这一步设**，72MHz 必须传 FLASH_LATENCY_2，传少了会跑飞、传多了只是慢一点。
prerequisites: 已用 HAL_RCC_OscConfig 打开 HSE 并配置好 PLL
remarks: The SystemCoreClock CMSIS variable is used to store System Clock Frequency and updated by @ref HAL_RCC_GetHCLKFreq() function called within this function

The HSI is used (enabled by hardware) as system clock source after start-up from Reset, wake-up from STOP and STANDBY mode, or in case of failure of the HSE used directly or indirectly as system clock (if the Clock Security System CSS is enabled).

A switch from one clock source to another occurs only if the target clock source is ready (clock stable after start-up delay or PLL locked). If a clock source which is not yet ready is selected, the switch will occur when the clock source will be ready. You can use @ref HAL_RCC_GetClockConfig() function to know which clock is currently used as system clock source.
notesZh: APB1 最高只能 36MHz，分频配成 DIV1 跑 72MHz 会读数异常甚至死机
调完必须调 SystemCoreClockUpdate()，否则 HAL_Delay 之外的很多基于 SystemCoreClock 的计算（串口波特率、定时器分频）全部错
FLatency 与主频不匹配是最隐蔽的错误：表现为偶发死机或读 Flash 数据错乱

params.name: RCC_MCOx
params.descEn: specifies the output direction for the clock source. This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: MCO 输出引脚，F1 上只有 RCC_MCO1（PA8）。

params.name: RCC_MCOSource
params.descEn: specifies the clock source to output. This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: 要输出的时钟源：RCC_MCO1SOURCE_SYSCLK / HSI / HSE / PLLCLK_DIV2。

params.name: RCC_MCODiv
params.descEn: specifies the MCO DIV. This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: 输出分频，RCC_MCODIV_1 ~ RCC_MCODIV_4。频率太高示波器探头会失真，建议至少 /2。

functions.briefEn: Selects the clock source to output on MCO pin.
functions.briefZh: 把内部时钟信号从 MCO 引脚（PA8）输出，用于示波器测量实际频率。
functions.usageZh: 验证时钟树是否真的跑在你以为的频率上——这是最直接的调试手段。可以选输出 SYSCLK、HSI、HSE 或 PLL/2。
prerequisites: PA8 已配成复用推挽输出（GPIO_MODE_AF_PP）
remarks: MCO pin should be configured in alternate function mode.
notesZh: PA8 被 MCO 占用后不能再当普通 GPIO 用；测完记得关掉

functions.name: HAL_RCC_EnableCSS
functions.briefZh: 使能时钟安全系统（CSS）：HSE 一旦失效自动切回 HSI 并触发 NMI 中断。
functions.usageZh: 产品级代码的保护措施。晶振因振动、虚焊、温漂停振时，CSS 能保证系统继续跑（切到内部 8MHz RC），而不是直接死机。使能后要重写 HAL_RCC_CSSCallback 在 NMI 里做降级处理。
remarks: If a failure is detected on the HSE oscillator clock, this oscillator is automatically disabled and an interrupt is generated to inform the software about the failure (Clock Security System Interrupt, CSSI), allowing the MCU to perform rescue operations. The CSSI is linked to the Cortex-M3 NMI (Non-Maskable Interrupt) exception vector.
notesZh: CSS 中断是 NMI（不可屏蔽），优先级最高，回调里不能做耗时操作
触发后 PLL 也被关掉，系统退到 HSI 8MHz，需要重新配置时钟
只在 HSE 作为系统时钟源时有意义

functions.name: HAL_RCC_DisableCSS
functions.briefZh: 关闭时钟安全系统。
functions.usageZh: 调试阶段不想被 NMI 打断时临时关掉；量产代码建议保持开启。

functions.name: HAL_RCC_GetSysClockFreq
functions.briefZh: 返回当前 SYSCLK 的实际频率（单位 Hz）。
functions.usageZh: 写通用驱动（尤其是需要按主频算波特率/定时器分频的库）时用它取实际频率，比硬编码 72000000 更稳妥。
remarks: The system frequency computed by this function is not the real frequency in the chip. It is calculated based on the predefined constant and the selected clock source:
If SYSCLK source is HSI, function returns values based on HSI_VALUE(*)
If SYSCLK source is HSE, function returns a value based on HSE_VALUE divided by PREDIV factor(**)
If SYSCLK source is PLL, function returns a value based on HSE_VALUE divided by PREDIV factor(**) or HSI_VALUE(*) multiplied by the PLL factor.
(*) HSI_VALUE is a constant defined in stm32f1xx_hal_conf.h file (default value 8 MHz) but the real value may vary depending on the variations in voltage and temperature.

(**) HSE_VALUE is a constant defined in stm32f1xx_hal_conf.h file (default value 8 MHz), user has to ensure that HSE_VALUE is same as the real frequency of the crystal used. Otherwise, this function may have wrong result.
The result of this function could be not correct when using fractional value for HSE crystal.
This function can be used by the user application to compute the baud-rate for the communication peripherals or configure other parameters.
Each time SYSCLK changes, this function must be called to update the right SYSCLK value. Otherwise, any configuration based on this function will be incorrect.

functions.name: HAL_RCC_GetHCLKFreq
functions.briefZh: 返回 AHB 总线（HCLK）频率，即内核实际运行的频率。
functions.usageZh: 算 SysTick、DWT 周期计数、以及任何「每周期多少」的场合都用它。
remarks: Each time HCLK changes, this function must be called to update the right HCLK value. Otherwise, any configuration based on this function will be incorrect.
The SystemCoreClock CMSIS variable is used to store System Clock Frequency and updated within this function

functions.name: HAL_RCC_GetPCLK1Freq
functions.briefZh: 返回 APB1 总线频率（PCLK1）。
functions.usageZh: 配置挂在 APB1 上的外设（USART2/3、TIM2~7、I2C、SPI2、PWR、BKP）时需要用它算波特率或定时器时基。
remarks: Each time PCLK1 changes, this function must be called to update the right PCLK1 value. Otherwise, any configuration based on this function will be incorrect.
notesZh: 注意定时器时钟不是 PCLK1：APB 分频不为 1 时，定时器时钟是 PCLK1 × 2

functions.name: HAL_RCC_GetPCLK2Freq
functions.briefZh: 返回 APB2 总线频率（PCLK2）。
functions.usageZh: 配置 USART1、SPI1、ADC1、GPIO、TIM1、AFIO 这些 APB2 外设时用它算分频。
remarks: Each time PCLK2 changes, this function must be called to update the right PCLK2 value. Otherwise, any configuration based on this function will be incorrect.

functions.usageZh: 和 HAL_RCC_GetOscConfig 配合，能完整还原时钟树配置。STOP 模式唤醒后常先读一次再决定怎么恢复。

functions.name: HAL_RCC_NMI_IRQHandler
functions.briefEn: This function handles the RCC CSS interrupt request.
functions.briefZh: CSS（时钟安全系统）中断的服务程序，内部清 CSS 标志并调用 HAL_RCC_CSSCallback。
functions.usageZh: 在 NMI_Handler() 里调用它。必须重写 HAL_RCC_CSSCallback 才有实际动作，否则 HSE 挂了系统会静默降频到 8MHz。
remarks: This API should be called under the NMI_Handler().
notesZh: NMI 优先级最高且不可屏蔽，回调里只能做很短的降级处理

functions.name: HAL_RCC_CSSCallback
functions.briefEn: RCC Clock Security System interrupt callback
functions.briefZh: 时钟安全系统的用户回调，__weak 空实现，HSE 失效时被调用。
functions.usageZh: 在这里做降级处理：把外设全部停掉、重新按 HSI 8MHz 配置时钟、必要时点亮故障灯或记录日志。
notesZh: 此时 PLL 已自动关闭，系统跑在 HSI 8MHz，所有按 72MHz 算的波特率/定时器参数都要重配
回调在 NMI 上下文，不要调用 HAL_Delay

functions.name: HAL_RCCEx_PeriphCLKConfig

params.name: PeriphClkInit
params.descEn: pointer to an RCC_PeriphCLKInitTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the Extended Peripherals clocks(RTC clock).
params.descZh: 结构体：PeriphClockSelection 选要配哪一项（RCC_PERIPHCLK_ADC / USB / RTC / I2S）；AdcClockSelection 取 RCC_ADCPCLK2_DIV2/4/6/8；RTCClockSelection 取 RCC_RTCCLKSOURCE_LSE/LSI/HSE_RTC；UsbClockSelection 取 RCC_USBCLKSOURCE_PLL_DIV1_5。

functions.briefEn: Initializes the RCC extended peripherals clocks according to the specified parameters in the RCC_PeriphCLKInitTypeDef.
functions.briefZh: 配置外设专用时钟源：ADC 预分频、USB 分频、RTC 时钟源、I2S 时钟源。
functions.usageZh: F1 里这些外设挂的不是普通总线时钟，需要单独选源与分频。最常用的是给 RTC 选 LSE、给 ADC 设 /6 分频让 ADC 时钟不超过 14MHz。
prerequisites: 对应的源时钟（LSE/HSE）已由 HAL_RCC_OscConfig 打开
remarks: Care must be taken when HAL_RCCEx_PeriphCLKConfig() is used to select the RTC clock source; in this case the Backup domain will be reset in order to modify the RTC Clock source, as consequence RTC registers (including the backup registers) are set to their reset values.
In case of STM32F105xC or STM32F107xC devices, PLLI2S will be enabled if requested on one of 2 I2S interfaces. When PLLI2S is enabled, you need to call HAL_RCCEx_DisablePLLI2S to manually disable it.
notesZh: ADC 时钟不能超过 14MHz，72MHz 下至少 /6（12MHz）
USB 要求精确 48MHz，只能用 PLL/1.5
改 RTC 时钟源前要先 HAL_RCC_DisableRTC 并备份域可写
